text: Heather is amazing at her craft and we are blessed forever by having this gorgeous painting of our family. She has it all planned out when she talks to you and listens to your feedback! She answers questions in a timely manner and is helpful with anything you may need as a client. I also loved the fact that she makes sure you’re happy as a customer multiple times. With all of this, I recommend her to be anyone’s wedding painter. She did a fantastic job, was the talk of my wedding (everyone thought it was so cool to have a live painter!), and we’re happy with our decision.
